about_the_game:
Lost at Birth will tell the story of a rather ordinary guy.
Stable job, nice house, comfortable routine, married, with no kids… that he knows of.

In short, his life is pleasantly boring.

To spice things up he has some fun on the side that his wife doesn't need to know about. Then things turn upside-down when a young woman comes into his life…with a birth certificate.


This is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel featuring:

-Over 2100 static images and several animated scenes
-2-3 hours of game
-Top notch graphic fidelity and realism.
-Discover a variety of characters with different and interesting personalities.
-A realistic and interesting story that explores complex relationships.
-Choose how the mc acts selecting your choices.
-Music that adjusts to the scene's mood.
-Sound effects.


Pursue or change your relationship with the new people in your life.


Try to stop your sex addiction and save your marriage.


Forget about all the people in your past and fall into a life of sex and hedonism.

content_descriptors.notes:
Sexual intercourse, cheating, alcohol and sex addiction are present in the game.

The game also includes scenes of incest related to genetic sexual attraction involving the main characters.

There's depictions of cheating on a partner that could be triggering for some people.

There's some scenes containing alcohol abuse or referencing it.

One of the characters is alcoholic and the game depicts situations that could trigger some people that had experienced similar problems.

In a scene there's depictions of harsh working conditions (Chapter 3) related to abuse of power in the work environment that could be triggering for some people.

Please, note that all characters in the game are 18 age or older.

All sexual acts in the game are consensual.
